caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Jan 11–16.

Hot-desking at a new office? Set the screen an arm's length away with the top at eye level. Learn the kettlebell swing with a wall hinge: push your hips back to touch the wall, 5 reps. New to skipping? Start with 30 seconds on, 30 seconds off. After a massage, keep it to a walk or easy ride and save heavy lifts for the next day.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Pain spreading into a leg, or pins and needles, is worth an assessment. Book online via the link in bio
